repos_data.description: Unofficial MCP server for the Tripo 3D API (v3): text/image/multiview to 3D, P1/P2 low-poly, texturing, retopology, Smart UV, segmentation, rigging, animation, format conversion, Gaussian splats. Go, stdio, Claude Code plugin.
PicoBerry MCP server — an AI 3D workspace for games, VR, and beyond. Generate, remesh, texture, and animate 3D assets from any MCP client. Multi-engine, one API.
